resources.string: Read the gaps, plan your ricochets and find your way through an ever-changing greenhouse.
Pull, aim, release.\nFlowers are the only places to hold on. Go around brambles or use their bounce to reach the next flower. The gauge on the right shows launch power.

Drag and release: Mochi flies in the opposite direction. The fixed gauge on the right shows power from 0 to 100%. Move back near the start of your gesture to cancel.

Only flowers let you hold on and launch again. Mochi grabs a flower on contact, from below, above or either side. A precise landing on a new, higher flower builds your streak, up to ×5. An off-centre landing, return or rescue breaks it.

Brambles bounce Mochi back but never let you rest or launch. Falling onto them without enough momentum stings. Light green brambles preserve more speed. A ricochet followed by landing on a new flower earns a bonus; bouncing alone earns nothing.

Purple flowers move, blue ones boost your jump and coral ones wilt after three seconds spent on them. Easy mode widens landings and keeps separate records.

Detours and golden fruit are worth more. Rest stops are on stages 10, 22, 36, 52, 70, then every 20 stages. Develop at most two power families, three levels each, and carry one rescue bubble. Powers last for one ascent; the journal stays.
